name: WQLN PBS — 'Erie Eats' (local public-television dining series)
credible: PBS member-station original video series profiling Erie-area eateries and their owners; editorial local-news production, not a listings/rating site.

name: Edible Western New York (Edible Communities regional food magazine)
credible: Established regional food magazine in the national Edible Communities network with real editorial features on chefs and restaurants across the Lake Erie region.

name: Erie Arts & Culture — Refugee-Owned Business Directory
credible: Nonprofit arts-and-culture organization's vetted directory of former-refugee-owned Erie businesses (compiled with USCRI / International Institute of Erie); a community/nonprofit feature on the refugee food scene, which the Erie brief accepts as credible.

name: Cucumber Chef — Jennie Geisler's food blog
credible: Personal food blog of Jennie Geisler, the Erie Times-News dining writer (17-year food columnist, 'Erielicious' newsletter) — a verifiably authoritative local food journalist with a real track record.
